# device42_vrf_group (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_vrf_group" "myNewVrfGroup" {
   name        = "myNewVrfGroup"
   description = "my new VRF group"
   tags        = "prod,core"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the VRF group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the VRF group.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags. The API appends tags on update, so drift is ignored when the configured tags are a subset of the existing ones.

### Read-Only

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom fields associated with the VRF group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
